$comment: zDSH dependency-face lint configuration (A2, upgrade process v2.0 section 6). Contract face = the published host surface plugin repositories may import (bare package specifiers and their declared export subpaths such as /client). Anything under the host org outside the contract face is a violation: deep-path reaches into src/internal, build-output (dist, lib) segments, or direct source files; internal-face imports of host wiring packages; and non-contract-face imports of unpublished or non-plugin-facing host packages. defaultTargets = the six true-source repositories carrying the eight factory-seeded artifacts (seed.json entries: webstack-verticals/webstack-bridge/webstack live in WebStack; omnivision in Omnivision; filehub in FileHub; plugin-center in PluginCenter; autopilot in AutoPilot; workbench in Workbench). TC-O3 adds @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver to the contract face: the published host route-contract surface, consumed type-only by workbench. pluginsRoot accepts a relative path, resolved against the repository root and therefore portable across workstations (the ../zDSH-plugins default assumes the plugins workspace is a sibling of the zDSH-main checkout), an absolute path, or the --plugins-root override. Exemptions are load-bearing records, not silencers: each needs a reason and is reported on every run.

exemptions.reason: zDSH-Go exclusive (process v2.0 D2/NG3): not in defaultTargets; its 372+ host imports / 15 deep paths are recorded legacy debt owned by the Go line, not gated here.
